name: Interval Table for Isosurface Extraction
definition: A pre-processing data structure that maps scalar value intervals to tetrahedron IDs, allowing the extraction algorithm to skip tetrahedra whose function span does not contain the isovalue.
summary: The Interval Table is a pre-processing data structure that maps scalar value intervals to tetrahedron IDs, enabling isosurface extraction algorithms to skip non-intersecting cells and drastically reduce visited tetrahedra.
